title: A 1v1 minesweeper-like game made with GPT Astra and Unity
author: DeliciousGorilla
selftext:
I’ve been building a little game where you plant a briefcase and lay mines for your opponent, then both cross each other’s boards to recover the case and escape. Clues are like minesweeper, fewer steps and trap hits wins, with time breaking ties.

* Unity + WebGL for the game, playable on desktop and mobile
* GPT Image 2.5 Sunburst for props, textures, characters, and UI artwork
* Hyper3D to turn character and prop images into 3D models
* Blender for cleanup, simplification, rigging, and animation work

Cost was 1.5 weeks of GPT Pro usage using Astra on xhigh only. Getting the generated assets looking consistent and working in-game took plenty of iteration!

You can play against a bot or invite a friend: [**patsygame.com**](https://patsygame.com)

Still a work in progress. Rounds are pretty quick, so up for ideas on how to make it more interesting.

replies.author: DeliciousGorilla
replies.body: I'm on the $100 GPT Pro plan. Used 1.5 weeks worth of usage in a couple of nights. But I had 3 banked resets at hand, so it's smooth sailing. For Hyper3D I did $30/mo but just using it for 1 month. And yup music is next, will be there on next push. Suno is great for jazzy instrumental stuff, fits the Noir vibe. Baked in an ambient harbor soundscape from [freesound.org](http://freesound.org) too.
